findings: Eight native views and the unchanged source crop/fixed SNL2 overlay inspected. Isometric shows two installed castings, support rails and inherited flywheel/clutch context; engine internals and case hardware remain pending.

Upper casting has twelve V-bank openings and seven paired rib stations per side. Revised underside view exposes the five windowed intermediate webs, solid end/nose webs, seven bearing seats, extended nose receiver and dry gear-chamber floor. Compare LIB14/15; exact profiles, stud bosses, rib stock and fillets remain estimates.

Lower view exposes integral bearing saddles, transverse webs, the central trough and large lower pump opening. These are consistent with the feature arrangement of LIB16/17/96 and SNL14, but the cubic bowl sections and rectangular access windows are approximations. The casting lacks its separate bearing inserts, pipes, studs and fittings.

Cylinder-bay section shows the two inclined roof openings, inward-open support rails and curved sump wall. Lower curves retain degree3 control poles and measured8mm minimum section separation; this is selected stock, not a printed historical dimension.

Front-yoke section exposes the dropped symmetric arms around the sump, retained rail seats and lowered pivot. Exact saved-shape clearance is4.39224806478028mm. Section cuts omit material outside their slabs; isolated ring/rivet contours in these display sections do not imply disconnected native solids.

Longitudinal section exposes the extended nose bearing receiver, six shorter seats, hollow main bays, separating distribution floor and lower wells. The retained breather and inclined roof passages no longer cut through the last bearing web or dry floor.

Fixed SNL2 projection places cylinder receivers near the drawn cylinder-base row and the lower casting in the sump region, but outlines and end registration differ. The inherited conditional source-axis discrepancy is about21mm. No scale, station or drawing fit was changed to hide these differences; engine/flywheel axial alignment remains unqualified.

HB44 pitch and nose dimension, HB45 bore/shaft and LIB bank angle are conditional aviation-to-tank transfers. SNL lower/upper bearing-length conflict and six tank mounts versus seven aviation positions remain unresolved. Cast profiles and support contour are not historically qualified.

Initial underside/lower camera views and original receipt/renderer are retained under diagnostics/initial_detail_views. Refreshed views expose the interiors more directly without changing any native geometry.
